result_text:
The export now builds `all_files.zip` from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer drops `all_files.zip` or `git-history.zip`. The reports module compiles and its one existing test passes, but I did not run a renamed-aspect export, so that case is verified by reading the code only.

**Change:** in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` (`exportJson`), the hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name and file lookup comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose files. The order stays main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` block is untouched; it was only failing because the exception from the `all_files.zip` lookup skipped it.

The module test run used `mvn -o -pl reports test`. No changes are committed.
